body:
I suggest to revise requirement v2.12 from:
- Verify that all **suspicious** authentication decisions are logged. This should include requests with relevant metadata needed for security investigations.

to:
- Verify that all ~~suspicious~~ authentication decisions are logged. This should include requests with relevant metadata needed for security investigations.

In my opinion:
- the definition of suspicious is subjective and lack a common definition
- all authentication decisions must be logged

comments.body: Logged and retained for an appropriate data retention period. Whenever space is an issue, the logs are the first to be deleted by system administrators, sometimes really quickly - as in after 10 or 15 days.

Although I agree with your general security suggestion I don't believe that ASVS should cover log retention requirements. It's more a operational requirement than an application requirement. 

Furthermore the word *_appropriate *_ is subjective.

title: requirement v2.12 revise proposal: Verify that all authentication decisions are logged
